cases.sentence: Если хочешь, зови, только кто ответит, кого из святых позовешь на ___?
cases.explain: The preposition 'на' (to/for) with the sense of 'calling to' governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Я видел сам, как глупец укоренился, но нежданно его дом был ___.
cases.explain: The past passive participle of 'проклясть' (to curse).

cases.sentence: У детей его нет ___, их бьют в суде, но некому их спасти.
cases.explain: The negative construction 'нет' (there is no) requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Голодный ест его урожай и даже то, что растет среди ___, а жаждущий уносит его добро.
cases.explain: The preposition 'между' (among) requires the instrumental, but 'среди' with genitive is also used; here using genitive form.

cases.sentence: Что до меня, то я бы воззвал к Богу. Богу бы доверил свое ___.
cases.explain: The verb 'доверить' (to commit/entrust) governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он творит великое и непостижимое, бесчетные ___.
cases.explain: The verb 'творит' (does/performs) governs the accusative case for direct object.

cases.sentence: Он ловит мудрых на их же ___ и замыслы коварных рушатся.
cases.explain: The preposition 'на' (on/in) governs the prepositional case when expressing means or location.

cases.sentence: От шести беды тебя избавит, и ___ беда тебя не коснется.
cases.explain: The ordinal number feminine 'седьмая' modifies the feminine noun 'беда' in nominative case.

reading.ru: Если хочешь, зови, только кто ответит, кого из святых позовешь на помощь?
reading.question: What does Eliphaz ask Job about calling for help?
options: If you call, who will answer? To which of the holy ones will you turn?
You should call upon the wise men of the land for guidance
God promises to answer all those who call upon Him
Only Job can help himself through his own righteousness
reading.correct: If you call, who will answer? To which of the holy ones will you turn?
reading.explain: Eliphaz's challenge: 'Если хочешь, зови, только кто ответит, кого из святых позовешь на помощь?' (If you call, who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?).

reading.ru: Я видел сам, как глупец укоренился, но нежданно его дом был проклят.
reading.question: What does Eliphaz observe about the fool's fate?
options: A fool took root but suddenly his dwelling was cursed
The fool grew wealthy and prospered for many years
Even the fool can achieve lasting success if he works hard
The fool's children inherited his wealth and status
reading.correct: A fool took root but suddenly his dwelling was cursed
reading.explain: Eliphaz's observation: 'глупец укоренился, но нежданно его дом был проклят' (a fool took root, but suddenly his dwelling was cursed).

reading.ru: Он творит великое и непостижимое, бесчетные чудеса.
reading.question: What does Eliphaz say about God's works?
options: God does great and unfathomable things, marvelous things without number
God's works are limited to healing and protection
God's works can be fully understood by wise men
God performs miracles only for those who deserve them
reading.correct: God does great and unfathomable things, marvelous things without number
reading.explain: Eliphaz's description: 'Он творит великое и непостижимое, бесчетные чудеса' (He does great things that cannot be fathomed, marvelous things without number).

reading.ru: Он посылает на землю дождь и орошает поля.
reading.question: How does God care for the earth?
options: He sends rain on the earth and waters the fields
He destroys the crops of the wicked and blesses the righteous
He withholds rain as punishment for sin
He provides crops without need for water or cultivation
reading.correct: He sends rain on the earth and waters the fields
reading.explain: The text states: 'Он посылает на землю дождь и орошает поля' (He gives rain to the earth and waters the fields).

reading.ru: Как блажен тот, кого вразумляет Бог, не презирай наставления всемогущего.
reading.question: What does Eliphaz say about those whom God corrects?
options: Happy is the man whom God corrects; do not despise the rebuke of the Almighty
Those who are corrected by God are marked for destruction
God's correction only applies to the wicked and sinful
Rejecting God's correction is a sign of great wisdom
reading.correct: Happy is the man whom God corrects; do not despise the rebuke of the Almighty
reading.explain: Eliphaz teaches: 'Как блажен тот, кого вразумляет Бог, не презирай наставления всемогущего' (Blessed is the one whom God corrects; do not despise the discipline of the Almighty).

reading.ru: От шести несчастья тебя избавит, и седьмая беда тебя не коснется.
reading.question: What promise does Eliphaz make about divine protection?
options: God will deliver you from six troubles, and the seventh will not touch you
No troubles will come to those who trust in God
God will deliver only the seventh trouble but not the earlier ones
All troubles must be endured without God's intervention
reading.correct: God will deliver you from six troubles, and the seventh will not touch you
reading.explain: Eliphaz's promise: 'От шести несчастья тебя избавит, и седьмая беда тебя не коснется' (He will deliver you from six troubles, and the seventh will not touch you).
